raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the 1989 initial handmade release of Icehouse with the later product “Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set,” which BoardGameGeek lists as 1999, and incorrectly tied that early date to Looney Labs. This misattribution (edition/year/publisher confusion) shows a failure to distinguish between the original Icehouse sets (1989) and the 1999 boxed Martian Chess Set, despite available cues indicating 1999 on the BGG page.
